description: The NATIONAL half of the FD CODE-SET clause - alphabet-name-2 (the second name of the IS form) and the FOR ALPHANUMERIC / FOR NATIONAL phrases, ISO 13.18.13.2 - introduced 2002 with the national repertoire (the '85 format was CODE-SET IS alphabet-name-1 alone). Parse-arm gated (VisitCodeSetClause); kb/Work PB110.
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. PB110CS.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
SPECIAL-NAMES.
    ALPHABET STD IS STANDARD-1.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F1 ASSIGN TO "f1.dat".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F1 CODE-SET FOR ALPHANUMERIC IS STD.
01 R1 PIC X(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    STOP RUN.
